Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?

Yes, you can absolutely have it arrive gift-ready, and you have some control over timing.

Gift-ready details

During checkout, check the box that says “Add a gift.” You can type a personal message there.
We print that on a small card with a rose on the front and your note on the back, so the recipient knows it’s from you.
For any order you’re sending as a gift, just put their address as the shipping address and your address as the billing address.
If you choose something like the Bloom & Prune Gift Set, it already feels like a thought-out present (tools + gloves + gift card), not just a single loose item.

How fast it can ship

At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar where you can pick an estimated arrival date that works for you.
Available dates are based on processing plus standard ground transit time to their location; you can usually choose dates up to about 8 months ahead.
